newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGIP to get 3.2 billion francs from CCK stake.
newsitem.headline: CGIP to get 3.2 billion francs from CCK stake.

text.p: French holding group CGIP said it had exercised its option to sell an extra 15 percent of shares in paper group Crown Cork and Seal on Monday following an earlier sale of a stake on October 25.
It said that as a result it would get a net amount of 3.2 billion francs on October 30.
CGIP, Compagnie Generale d'Industrie et de Participations, sold 9,250,000 shares of Crown Cork common stock and three million shares of 4.5 percent convertible preference stock on October 25.
After the 15-percent option, CGIP will keep a 10.1 percent stake in Crown Cork's voting share capital.
CGIP obtained a stake in Crown Cork when the U.S. group acquired CarnaudMetalbox earlier this year. CGIP was the main shareholder in CarnaudMetalbox.
